chunks: And everything in it that is narrated from Kurduwayh al-Hamdani, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Kurduwayh al-Hamdani.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father, referring to the author's father in the chain
key_terms.الْهَمْدَانِيِّ: Al-Hamdani, a tribal nisba indicating lineage or origin
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it, indicating the author's direct transmission

ai.seo_question: How is the transmission chain for Kurduwayh al-Hamdani's narrations established in this text?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq clarifies the specific isnad for narrations from Kurduwayh al-Hamdani, tracing the chain through his father, Ali ibn Ibrahim, and his grandfather, Ibrahim ibn Hashim. This explicit linkage underscores the reliability of the transmission within the prominent al-Saduq family lineage, a key feature in Shia hadith scholarship for verifying authenticity. By specifying this direct line, the author reinforces the scholarly rigor and continuity of the Imami tradition.
